faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore) for filling up Academic Associate positions in the Marketing Area.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Academic Associate - Marketing Area under advertisement number IIMB/HR/RECT/2026/55.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Academic Associate - Marketing Area position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or PG Diploma with a specialization in Marketing to be eligible for applying to this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Academic Associate post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from ₹ 43,000/- to ₹ 55,000/- per month on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIM Bangalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official application portal provided by IIM Bangalore.

faq.question: Q7. When is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 12 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based employment opportunity offered by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore in Karnataka, Bangalore.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their submitted applications and documents, followed by direct intimation to the shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the direct link to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can find the direct link to apply online as well as the official notification PDF under the Important Links section of this article.
